spec.claim_summary: Buy when the daily close crosses above the 200-day moving average and exit when it falls below.

claimed.other: The most recent trade that started after the crash of March 2020 returned 388%

assumptions: Asset not named in claim text; page context indicates BTC so compiled as BTCUSDT.
'200 days moving average' / '200 DMA' interpreted as 200-period simple moving average.
Direction is long from buy to enter and liquidate to exit.
Timeframe 1d from daily close and once-a-day check.
Exit encoded as close crosses_below 200-period SMA to mirror entry crossing language; first signal bar is same as close below.
No stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stop or max hold stated; position held until opposite signal.
388% refers to a single recent trade, recorded in claimed.other, not total strategy return.

evidence.quote: Buy when the daily close is crossing above the 200 days moving average.
Liquidate the position when the daily close falls back down below the 200 DMA.
check the price once a day
The most recent trade that started after the crash of March 2020 returned 388%
